description: Renovate config for this personal repository. Self-contained: it extends only Renovate's built-in presets, so it never depends on another account's repository.

schedule: before 7am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Hold every npm update until the release is 3 days old, so a broken or pulled release has time to be noticed upstream.
Patch updates to devDependencies merge themselves once the required checks pass. They cannot change what the site serves.
Next.js packages move together in one reviewed PR, so next and eslint-config-next never drift apart.
conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits v10 produces empty release notes with @semantic-release/release-notes-generator 14. Stay on v9 until a compatible release-notes-generator ships.
